name: Suzukura Rin
source:
A member of the student council with a strong personality. She is Arika's childhood and best friend. Rin used to be shy, but her personality has become stronger and more towards "Tsundere" type. She does know know much about sexual topics, and often avoid it
When transformed, her weapon is a rapier and she fights in close-quarter combat
